movable_cycle_events.title: Sunday of the Publican and the Pharisee
movable_cycle_events.description: Beginning of the Lenten Triodion. Fast-free week.

movable_cycle_events.title: Sunday of the Prodigal Son
movable_cycle_events.description: Parable of the Prodigal Son: repentance and forgiveness.

movable_cycle_events.title: Meatfare Sunday (Sunday of the Last Judgment)
movable_cycle_events.description: Last day meat is permitted before Great Lent.

movable_cycle_events.title: Cheesefare Week Begins
movable_cycle_events.description: No meat; dairy, eggs, and fish permitted every day.

movable_cycle_events.title: Cheesefare Sunday (Forgiveness Sunday / Expulsion of Adam)
movable_cycle_events.description: Forgiveness Sunday and mutual asking of pardon before Great Lent.

movable_cycle_events.title: Clean Monday — Beginning of Great Lent
movable_cycle_events.description: First day of the holy Forty Days of Great Lent.

movable_cycle_events.title: Sunday of Orthodoxy (First Sunday of Great Lent)
movable_cycle_events.description: Restoration of the Holy Icons and triumph over iconoclasm.

movable_cycle_events.title: Sunday of St. Gregory Palamas (Second Sunday of Great Lent)
movable_cycle_events.description: Commemoration of St. Gregory Palamas and the Divine Uncreated Light.

movable_cycle_events.title: Sunday of the Holy Cross (Third Sunday of Great Lent)
movable_cycle_events.description: Veneration of the Precious and Life-Giving Cross of the Lord.

movable_cycle_events.title: Sunday of St. John Climacus (Fourth Sunday of Great Lent)
movable_cycle_events.description: Commemoration of St. John Climacus, author of The Ladder of Divine Ascent.

movable_cycle_events.title: Sunday of St. Mary of Egypt (Fifth Sunday of Great Lent)
movable_cycle_events.description: Commemoration of St. Mary of Egypt, exemplar of repentance.

movable_cycle_events.title: Lazarus Saturday (Resurrection of Righteous Lazarus)
movable_cycle_events.description: Assurance of the universal resurrection before Christ's Passion.

movable_cycle_events.title: Palm Sunday — The Entry of the Lord into Jerusalem
movable_cycle_events.description: One of the Twelve Great Feasts. Fish allowed.

movable_cycle_events.title: Great and Holy Monday
movable_cycle_events.description: Commemoration of Joseph the Patriarch and the barren fig tree.

movable_cycle_events.title: Great and Holy Tuesday
movable_cycle_events.description: Parable of the Ten Virgins and spiritual vigilance.

movable_cycle_events.title: Great and Holy Wednesday
movable_cycle_events.description: The anointing of Christ with myrrh and the betrayal by Judas.

movable_cycle_events.title: Great and Holy Thursday — The Mystical Supper
movable_cycle_events.description: Institution of the Holy Eucharist and Mystical Supper.

movable_cycle_events.title: Great and Holy Friday — The Crucifixion of Christ
movable_cycle_events.description: The Holy Passion, Crucifixion and Burial of Jesus Christ. Strict fast.

movable_cycle_events.title: Great and Holy Saturday — Christ in the Tomb
movable_cycle_events.description: Christ's bodily rest in the tomb and descent into Hades.

movable_cycle_events.title: The Bright and Glorious Resurrection of Christ (Pascha)
movable_cycle_events.description: The Feast of Feasts and Solemnity of Solemnities. Christ is Risen!

movable_cycle_events.title: Bright Monday
movable_cycle_events.description: Bright Week. Fast-free.

movable_cycle_events.title: Bright Tuesday (Apparition of the Iveron Icon of Theotokos)
movable_cycle_events.description: Appearance of the Portaitissa (Iveron) Icon of the Mother of God.

movable_cycle_events.title: Bright Wednesday
movable_cycle_events.description: Bright Week. Fast-free.

movable_cycle_events.title: Bright Thursday
movable_cycle_events.description: Bright Week. Fast-free.

movable_cycle_events.title: Bright Friday (Life-Giving Spring of the Theotokos)
movable_cycle_events.description: The Life-Giving Spring of the Mother of God.

movable_cycle_events.title: Bright Saturday (Distribution of Artos)
movable_cycle_events.description: Distribution of the Artos (Paschal bread) to the faithful.

movable_cycle_events.title: Thomas Sunday (Antipascha)
movable_cycle_events.description: Confession of St. Thomas: 'My Lord and my God!'

movable_cycle_events.title: The Ascension of our Lord Jesus Christ
movable_cycle_events.description: Fortieth day after Pascha. One of the Twelve Great Feasts.

movable_cycle_events.title: Pentecost (Descent of the Holy Spirit / Holy Trinity)
movable_cycle_events.description: Fiftieth day after Pascha. Birthday of the Church. Twelve Great Feast.

movable_cycle_events.title: Day of the Holy Spirit
movable_cycle_events.description: Monday after Pentecost, glorifying the Third Person of the Trinity.

movable_cycle_events.title: Sunday of All Saints
movable_cycle_events.description: First Sunday after Pentecost, commemorating all saints throughout history.

movable_cycle_events.title: Apostles' Fast Begins
movable_cycle_events.description: Monday after All Saints Sunday, continuing until SS Peter and Paul (July 12).
